count_invariant_bug.new_condition: state.tool_terminal_count != 1 rejects duplicate/missing terminating submits; terminal.tool_call_id must be present in tool_result_details, details must match terminal.details_value, and state.tool_result_details.len() == 1; total tool_execution_count is diagnostic only
count_invariant_bug.justification: Ordinary read/bash/grep tool executions may precede the terminal submit and Pi 0.83 ordinary toolResults legitimately omit details. The invariant is exactly one terminating submit and exactly one correlated details-bearing terminal submit toolResult, not exactly one total tool execution.

terminal_invariants_preserved: exactly one terminating submit tool is required
terminal submit must be isError=false and terminate=true
terminal submit tool_execution_end details must be present and parse as ToolCarrierDetails
terminal submit toolResult details must correlate by opaque tool_call_id
tool_execution_end details and toolResult details must match exactly
only one details-bearing toolResult is allowed in the terminal submit cycle
single-terminal cycles still reject tool activity after the terminal result
